title: Number of codec bits
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$, and let $n,s\ge 0$. The number of codec-bit positions is $n+(n+2)+(|Q|+1)+3k(2s+1)+2$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Boolean-alphabet Turing machine
